paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.89% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.85%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.40%). Brent crude changed +2.89% to 111.96. Gold changed -2.34% to 4,052.8999. Bitcoin changed -3.36% to 81,188.0. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.97%, a relative move of -3.42%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+6.56%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (-5.79%) moved the most.
